description: For arbitrary arithmetic terms \(x,y\), original names \(X\) and finite additional context \(\Gamma\), the specified cancellation operation consumes an actual HA certificate of \((x+\overline2)+y=(x+\overline2)+\overline3\) and returns one of \(y=\overline3\), with the same context and original names. The shared addend need not be a numeral.
